note: Hand-labeled golden set, written BEFORE the first pipeline run against these fixtures (expectations, not back-fitted answers). expectedFindings measures extraction recall: each entry is evidence a careful human reviewer agreed the submission contains. cardLabels (per committed run) measures precision: each extracted card hand-labeled valid/invalid after the run, without editing the run. n=2 synthetic fixtures — all numbers are illustrative of the mechanism, not a validation claim.
revisions: After the first run: (1) widened the substring matchers on exp-a-01 and exp-a-09 — both findings WERE extracted, citing different spans of the same passages than my matchers anticipated; the expectations are unchanged, the matchers were brittle. (2) Corrected exp-b-02's competency from C3 to C1 — my original label was wrong: vision claims with no mechanism are a framing finding, not a builder-execution finding, and the extractor's assignment was the defensible one. All revisions disclosed here and in DECISIONS.md.
